questions.question: Which of the following is/are not a type of transducer?
questions.explanation: A transducer converts energy from one form to another. Speakers, microphones and solar panels perform such conversion; a connecting wire mainly carries the signal or power, so it is the exception.

It provides the smallest change in the input that a sensor is capable of sensing.

questions.explanation: Resolution is the smallest input change the sensor can distinguish. Accuracy concerns agreement with the reference value; it does not mean the smallest detectable step.

End device manages and controls the network
End devices contribute in data relaying

questions.explanation: Multiple people and devices create more points at which healthcare data can be altered. The key therefore identifies tampering risk as high; security is needed even when the data flow is useful.

questions.question: Which of the following is/are the major challenge(s) associated with the healthcare industry?

questions.question: Which of the following is a body temperature monitoring device?

questions.question: Which of the following does not represents the challenge of IIoT in a power plant?

questions.question: State true or false — RFID tagging system comprises of RFID tag, read/write devices, and a host system.
questions.explanation: An RFID system combines tags, read/write devices (readers) and a host system. The tag’s identity/data is only one part of the complete information path.

questions.question: Which of the following is true about passive RFID tags?
options: Broadcasts information signals in the form of a beacons
Have longer range than active RFID tags
Bulky and expensive as compared to active RFID
questions.explanation: A passive tag responds using backscatter of the reader’s signal. Broadcasting beacons is associated with active tags; passive tags generally do not have the range and onboard-power arrangement claimed in the other choices.

questions.question: Match the following. Types of Network Security Description 1. Firewalls i. Provide access based on user identity 2. Intrusion prevention systems ii. Scan for malware detection and prevention 3. Access control iii. Barrier between the trusted internal network and the external networks 4. Antivirus and antimalware software iv. Detection and blocking attacks
questions.explanation: Firewalls separate networks under rules; intrusion prevention detects/blocks attacks; access control uses identity/permissions; antivirus and antimalware scan for malicious software. The match aligns each security mechanism with its specific job.

questions.explanation: Both smart meters and security/safety alarms are facility-management applications. They support monitoring of resource use and the condition or safety of the premises.

questions.question: Which of the following does not represents the benefit of the IIoT applications in inventory management?
options: Automation in the process of inventory tracking and packing
Inability to recognize the reason behind the bottlenecks in the operation
Optimization of the amount of inventory
Real-time update of the quantity of inventory items, their location, and tracking
questions.explanation: Inability to identify bottleneck causes is a limitation, not a benefit. The intended IIoT benefits are automated tracking/packing, appropriate inventory levels and real-time item visibility.

Power supply is provided from micro-grids, local distribution companies
Advanced metering infrastructure for bi-directional communication

questions.question: IIoT can be deployed in inventory management to automate which of the following activities?
questions.explanation: Inventory automation includes both stock-in and stock-out. Recording arrivals without departures, or departures without arrivals, would leave the inventory state incomplete.

options: Detects abnormal behavior by the network
Establishes a connection between the sender and receiver
Generates new routes across the network
questions.explanation: Behavioural analytics looks for abnormal network behaviour that may indicate an incident. It is an analysis/detection function, not the basic job of creating connections or routes.
